notes: Stores DirectDraw surface pointer and source filename in the global reload registry

name: ReloadRegisteredBitmapSurfaces

notes: Directly opens loaddata\\NumUiHotArea.txt

notes: Directly opens loaddata\\uiHotAreaReplace.txt

notes: Directly opens loaddata\\uiBitmapName.txt

notes: Directly opens loaddata\\playagain.txt

name: LoadQuitConfirmationData
notes: Directly opens loaddata\\quitsure.txt

name: LoadVideoSequence
notes: Directly opens loaddata\\videoseq.txt

name: LoadBinkWalkthroughTable
notes: Directly opens loaddata\\binkwalk.txt

notes: Loads loaddata\\startupmovie.txt followed by loaddata\\completedmovie.txt

name: LoadGlobalDataTables
notes: Calls the UI/options/movie table loaders in sequence

name: InitializeDirectInput
notes: Calls DirectInput8Create and configures DirectInput interfaces/devices

name: InitializeBinkPlaybackSystem
notes: Initializes Bink playback geometry and binds Bink audio to DirectSound

name: SoundManagerConstructor
notes: Initializes 80 active sound slots and parses data\\sound\\binklist.txt filename-to-sound-ID catalog

name: ReleaseSoundSlot
notes: Releases a managed sound buffer group and clears its slot/reverse-ID mapping

name: AnyManagedSoundPlaying
notes: Scans the 80 managed slots and returns whether any active sound is playing

name: IsSoundIdPlaying
notes: Uses sound-ID-to-slot reverse map then tests the DirectSound buffer group status

name: StopAllManagedSounds
notes: Scans all 80 active slots and stops playing managed sounds

name: StopSoundSlot
notes: Marks a slot stopped, stops all buffers in its group, and rewinds them to position zero

name: PlaySoundById
notes: Managed sound playback entry; resolves/reuses or loads a sound ID and applies playback flags

name: AcquireAndPlaySound
notes: Finds or evicts one of 80 slots, builds data\\sound\\%s, loads the buffer group, and starts playback

name: ReapFinishedSounds
notes: Reclaims finished non-persistent managed sound slots

name: PlaySoundBufferGroup
notes: Chooses an available DirectSound buffer from a group, applies volume, and calls Play

name: StopAllBuffersInGroup
notes: Calls IDirectSoundBuffer::Stop for every buffer in a sound group

name: RewindAllBuffersInGroup
notes: Calls IDirectSoundBuffer::SetCurrentPosition(0) for every buffer in a sound group

name: IsAnyBufferPlaying
notes: Calls IDirectSoundBuffer::GetStatus and tests DSBSTATUS_PLAYING across a buffer group

name: LoadCreditsSlideshow
notes: Parses loaddata\\credits.txt and loads up to ten timed credit bitmap surfaces

name: UpdateCreditsSlideshow
notes: Advances timed credit images and releases them when the slideshow completes

name: RunMainGameFlow
notes: Central 68-state high-level dispatcher keyed by global game-flow state at 0x0044DE14

name: InitializeHerdingActivity
notes: Activity initializer in Data\\SubGame1 herd module; called by main flow state 0x0E

name: UpdateHerdingActivity
notes: Runtime/update entry paired with InitializeHerdingActivity by main flow state 0x0F

name: InitializeDinoActivity
notes: Dinosaur activity initializer; references Dino asset/difficulty tables

name: UpdateDinoActivity
notes: Dinosaur activity runtime/update entry paired with state 0x15

name: InitializeSpudSkateActivity
notes: Spud Skate activity initializer; paired with data loaders for spuddata1/2/3.txt

name: UpdateSpudSkateActivity
notes: Spud Skate runtime/update entry; called by main flow state 0x1B

name: InitializeMazeActivity
notes: Maze activity initializer; loads Data\\SubGameMaze assets and lofty engine.wav

name: UpdateMazeActivity
notes: Maze runtime/update entry paired with state 0x21

name: InitializeFireworksActivity
notes: Fireworks activity initializer; references fireworks.txt/fireworkboxes.txt and graph assets

name: UpdateFireworksActivity
notes: Fireworks runtime/update entry; references fireworkcomplete.bik

name: InitializeSquirrelActivity
notes: Squirrel activity initializer; loads Data\\SubGameSquirrel assets and sqdata.txt

name: UpdateSquirrelActivity
notes: Squirrel runtime/update entry paired with state 0x29

name: InitializeGrandOpeningActivity
notes: Initializes Data\\SubGameOpen music/sequencer activity and its character instrument tracks

name: UpdateGrandOpeningActivity
notes: Runtime/update entry paired with Grand Opening activity state 0x2F

name: InitializeParkDesignerActivity
notes: Park Designer/SubGameDYP initializer

name: UpdateParkDesignerActivity
notes: Park Designer runtime/update entry paired with state 0x33

name: InitializeGolfActivity
notes: Golf initializer; loads Data\\SubGameGolf flag/ball/powerbar/background assets

name: UpdateGolfActivity
notes: Golf runtime/update entry paired with state 0x37

name: InitializeSpudMazeActivity
notes: Spud Maze initializer; loads screen/timer/repair/toolbar assets

name: UpdateSpudMazeActivity
notes: Spud Maze runtime/update entry paired with state 0x3B

name: SetPrimarySoundBufferFormat
notes: Builds PCM WAVEFORMATEX and calls primary IDirectSoundBuffer::SetFormat

name: CreateSoundBufferGroupFromWave
notes: Allocates CWaveFile-like reader and one-or-more DirectSound buffers from a WAV path

name: FillSoundBufferFromWave
notes: Locks a DirectSound buffer, reads WAV bytes, fills silence remainder, then unlocks

name: RestoreSoundBufferIfLost
notes: Checks DSBSTATUS_BUFFERLOST and loops IDirectSoundBuffer::Restore

name: GetFreeSoundBuffer
notes: Returns first non-playing duplicate buffer; otherwise chooses a random buffer

name: WaveFileConstructor
notes: Initializes the RIFF/WAV helper object fields

name: WaveFileDestructor
notes: Closes RIFF/WAV state and releases owned format memory

name: WaveFileOpen
notes: Opens WAV through mmioOpenA and initializes RIFF/WAVE parsing state

name: WaveFileReadFormat
notes: Parses RIFF/WAVE and fmt chunk, allocating/copying WAVEFORMATEX

name: WaveFileGetSize
notes: Returns cached WAV data size

name: WaveFileReset
notes: Seeks/descends back to the data chunk or resets memory cursor

name: WaveFileRead
notes: Reads WAV bytes through MMIO or from memory-backed data

name: WaveFileClose
notes: Closes MMIO handle and tears down WAV reader state

name: PlayActivityMusicByIndex
notes: Indexes the fixed activity-music path table, creates a DirectSound buffer group, and starts playback

name: StopActivityMusic
notes: Stops and releases the shared activity-music DirectSound buffer group

name: RestartBinkMovie
notes: Calls BinkGoto(handle,1,0) to seek a movie to its beginning

name: OpenBinkMovieWithFallback
notes: Calls BinkOpen with streaming flag and retries using alternate game/CD-root path

name: CloseBinkMovie
notes: Thin wrapper around BinkClose

name: OpenGlobalBinkMovie
notes: Opens a movie into the shared global HBINK and initializes playback state

name: CloseGlobalBinkMovie
notes: Closes and clears the shared global HBINK then restores shared input/display state

name: DecodeAndBlitBinkFrame
notes: BinkDoFrame + DirectDraw surface lock + BinkCopyToBuffer + frame advance/wait

name: DecodeAndBlitBinkFrameNoAdvance
notes: Variant Bink frame decode/copy helper used by playback paths

name: UpdateGlobalBinkMovie
notes: Decodes/blits shared movie, advances frames, detects completion, and closes on end

name: ApplyGlobalBinkVolume
notes: Computes movie volume from game volume and calls BinkSetVolume

name: PauseGlobalBinkMovie
notes: Calls BinkPause(1), mutes movie, and marks shared playback paused

name: ResumeGlobalBinkMovie
notes: Calls BinkPause(0), reapplies volume, and resumes shared playback
